shipLog.text: ◆ Docking at station. MARV notes that stations are where people who stopped traveling sell things to people who haven't yet. He has not decided which group is wiser.
◆ Seeds in medium. MARV notes the crop is the only passenger aboard expected to produce something. He has adjusted his expectations of the others accordingly.
Arrived: FSS Due Diligence. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Approaching the derelict. Once, someone looked at this ship the way you look at ours. MARV mentions this only because nobody else will.
Arrived: New Somewhere. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Soil Sample Paradise. The captain chose “Survey for water sources”. Noted.
Subsurface ice detected and extracted. +5 H2O, 2 DAYS. It will not last.
◆ Planetary approach. Gravity well, atmosphere, biosphere-adjacent readings. MARV lists these as hazards. He is technically correct, which is his favorite kind.
Arrived: Outpost Remember-To-Buy-Fuel. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
A Commercial Opportunity. The captain chose “Trade pleasantries and move on”. Noted.
You swap route gossip and weather reports — there is no weather, but… +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
